text: こばんが　あたりに　ちらばった！
note: The coins here are こばん (koban), the oval gold coins of Edo-period Japan, not generic coins.
claim: Koban were oval gold coins used in Japan during the Edo period.

check.quote: The koban (小判) was a Japanese oval gold coin, cast on the order of Tokugawa Ieyasu in Edo period.
